# A side written 0px beside a non-zero whole is 0, on every target; and a
# whole written 0px is written, on html.
#
# `flush` writes {padding=16px, paddingTop=0px} and `sides` writes the three
# other sides alone, so the two are one box and each target's snapshots of
# them must be the same picture. Every style function read a measurement at
# zero as unset, and a side unset takes its axis's, then the whole's, so
# `flush` was 16 on top everywhere but html. A Style's measurement fields are
# options now, and a side is the first of its own field, its axis's and the
# whole's that is not null.
#
# page.sngl asks the browser: the side is 0px, and a card written
# `padding=0px` has none, where html's own stylesheet pads one.

mkdir html bubbletea fyne gtk4 android
env SNGL_UPDATE_SNAPSHOTS=1

cp page.sngl html/page.sngl
sngl test --platform=html html/page.sngl
stdout 'ok +2 tests, 0 failures'

cp app.sngl bubbletea/app.sngl
sngl test --platform=bubbletea bubbletea/app.sngl
stdout 'PASS'
cmp bubbletea/app.sngl.snapshots/flush.ansi bubbletea/app.sngl.snapshots/sides.ansi

cp app.sngl fyne/app.sngl
sngl test --platform=fyne fyne/app.sngl
stdout 'PASS'
cmp fyne/app.sngl.snapshots/flush.png fyne/app.sngl.snapshots/sides.png

cp app.sngl gtk4/app.sngl
sngl test --platform=gtk4 gtk4/app.sngl
stdout 'PASS'
cmp gtk4/app.sngl.snapshots/flush.png gtk4/app.sngl.snapshots/sides.png

cp app.sngl android/app.sngl
sngl test --platform=android android/app.sngl
stdout 'PASS'
cmp android/app.sngl.snapshots/robolectric/flush.png android/app.sngl.snapshots/robolectric/sides.png

-- app.sngl --
import test "sngl:test"
import ui "sngl:ui"

component flush ui.node {
    ui.text(value="flush", style={padding=16px, paddingTop=0px, background=#336699, color=#ffffff})
}

component sides ui.node {
    ui.text(value="flush", style={paddingRight=16px, paddingBottom=16px, paddingLeft=16px, background=#336699, color=#ffffff})
}

func testFlush(t test.Test, c flush) {
    t.snapshot("flush")
}

func testSides(t test.Test, c sides) {
    t.snapshot("sides")
}

ui.window {
    flush
}
-- page.sngl --
import browser "sngl:test/browser"
import test "sngl:test"
import ui "sngl:ui"

component flush ui.node {
    ui.text #t(value="flush", style={padding=16px, paddingTop=0px})
}

component bare ui.node {
    ui.card #c(style={padding=0px}) {
        ui.text(value="bare")
    }
}

func testFlush(t test.Test, c flush) {
    t.assert(browser.style(c.t, "padding-top") == "0px")
    t.assert(browser.style(c.t, "padding-left") == "16px")
}

func testBare(t test.Test, c bare) {
    t.assert(browser.style(c.c, "padding-top") == "0px")
    t.assert(browser.style(c.c, "padding-left") == "0px")
}

ui.window {
    flush
}
